text:
nora: @here Announcing Lumen-2 (model_id=lumen-2) GA on Hosted API. This release activates streaming v3, tool-calling v3, and a new WebSocket realtime endpoint. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/lumen-2 :tada:

nora: WebSocket example (quick):
```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime?model=lumen-2', {headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${REDWOOD_KEY}`}});
ws.on('open', ()=> ws.send(JSON.stringify({input:'Generate onboarding steps',stream:true,tool_call:true})));
ws.on('message', (m)=> console.log('chunk',m));
```

jamal: Note: streaming SDK v1 and v2 deprecated; 120-day migration window. Migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate/realtime-to-v3

ricardo: Breaking change to surface: `tool_context` field renamed -> `tool_args_v2`. We added a backwards-compat shim for 30 days but advise customers to update. Non-JSON tool outputs will be coerced to string; strict parsing opt-in via `validation=strict`.

ops-bot: deploy: lumen-2-realtime canary rolled to eu-west-1 at 1830456905. Observability warming up.

infra: Small memory-leak regression detected in eu-west-1 canary at 1830456940; rolled back the canary for 20m while a GC tuning patch rolled forward. No customer-facing errors recorded. Patch rolled to canary again at 1830457020.

docs: Adding WebSocket examples and migration snippets for Ruby/Java in the Hosted docs. Also publishing telemetry event names: `redwood.lumen.request_start`, `redwood.lumen.stream_chunk`, `redwood.lumen.tool_call`, `redwood.lumen.kv_cache_miss`.

support-sre: KB created: "Lumen-2 GA: WebSocket & tool migration". Canned Zendesk reply added. Escalation tag: #lumen-2-ga.

nora: Limits for docs: default realtime concurrency = 220 streams/org, default token cap/stream = 80k. Enterprise increases via support SLA. Also note: no billing change this GA; we'll announce pricing separately.

jamal: For Dedicated/Private pinning use Console -> Models -> Variants -> Pin or API header `x-redwood-variant: lumen-1@<rev>` to lock. Pin preserves quantization profile.

nora: Customer-facing GA banner goes live in 15m. Internal rollout dashboard: Console -> Deployments -> Lumen-2. Post-GA sync 10:00 PT to review telemetry. Ping me for urgent issues. :rocket:
